title: Reliable Smart Updater downloads
summary: ARSAS 1.6.46 improves first-time Smart Updater downloads on Windows. Verified installers now complete the partial-file lifecycle safely before independent SHA-256 checks, while background update notifications remain non-disruptive to IEC 61850 engineering work.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.46 meningkatkan keandalan unduhan pertama Smart Updater di Windows. File installer kini ditutup dengan benar sebelum verifikasi SHA-256, sementara pemeriksaan update di background tetap tidak mengganggu pekerjaan engineering IEC 61850.
highlights: Fixed the first-update download failure: close and flush the exclusive .part file before independent size/SHA-256 verification and final installer cache rename.
Keep unsafe downloads out: incorrect file size or SHA-256 rejects the installer and removes incomplete temporary downloads.
Reuse verified packages: a trusted cached installer is checked again and does not require an unnecessary second download.
Stay in control: the app reviews updates after startup, downloads verified bytes in the background and asks the operator before installation.
Official stable Windows Setup and Portable EXE packages are published from one validated source with checksums, SPDX SBOM and provenance.
highlightsId: Memperbaiki kegagalan unduhan pertama: file .part ditutup dan di-flush sebelum pemeriksaan ukuran/SHA-256 dan pemindahan ke cache installer final.
Unduhan tidak aman ditolak: ukuran atau SHA-256 yang salah mencegah installer dipakai dan file sementara yang tidak lengkap dibersihkan.
Cache terverifikasi digunakan kembali: installer yang tersimpan diperiksa ulang tanpa perlu mengunduh paket yang sama lagi.
Kontrol tetap di pengguna: aplikasi memeriksa update setelah startup, mengunduh di background, dan meminta persetujuan sebelum instalasi.
Setup Windows dan Portable EXE resmi berasal dari source yang tervalidasi, dengan checksum, SPDX SBOM, dan provenance.
improvements: Automated download regression tests cover the actual first-time file/write/hash/rename path, verified cache reuse and rejection of mismatched hashes.
Stable and release-candidate updater caches remain isolated; deferral and the existing checked stable-manifest provenance are preserved.
The updater does not modify the connected IED, perform background installation, or silently interrupt IEC 61850 monitoring.

The Download Center receives version, package size, download targets and SHA-256 from the already published GitHub stable release; the Pages deployment is automatically triggered after synchronization.
improvementsId: Regression test unduhan otomatis mencakup alur file/write/hash/rename pertama, penggunaan ulang cache valid, dan penolakan SHA-256 yang tidak cocok.
Cache updater stable dan release candidate tetap terpisah; fitur penundaan serta verifikasi asal manifest stable tetap dipertahankan.
Updater tidak mengubah konfigurasi IED, tidak memasang update tanpa izin, dan tidak menghentikan monitoring IEC 61850 secara diam-diam.
Download Center menerima versi, ukuran paket, tautan unduhan, dan SHA-256 dari GitHub stable release yang sudah diterbitkan; deployment Pages dipicu otomatis setelah sinkronisasi.
knownLimitations: The SG7_BCU trace also recorded 4 BufOvfl indications and 28 SqNum discontinuities. These are not verified lost-event counts; lossless buffered SOE is not established.
Six-byte MMS BinaryTime has no clock-synchronization quality byte. Buffer classification uses corroborating evidence and does not certify IED clock quality.
Physical R7/R10 interoperability qualification and SCL/IID parity remain incomplete for the pinned ARIEC61850 trial engine; no universal device certification is implied.
Manual PurgeBuf destroys retained IED history. Use it only on an authorized, idle test BRCB after reviewing the consequences; ARSAS never runs it automatically.
Windows x64 installers are not Authenticode-signed; verify the published SHA-256. Raw GOOSE/SV capture needs approved Npcap, and control operations require an authorized procedure.
knownLimitationsId: Trace SG7_BCU juga mencatat 4 indikasi BufOvfl dan 28 diskontinuitas SqNum. Ini bukan jumlah event yang terbukti hilang; SOE buffer tanpa kehilangan belum terverifikasi.
MMS BinaryTime 6-byte tidak membawa byte kualitas sinkronisasi clock. Klasifikasi buffer memakai bukti gabungan dan bukan sertifikasi kualitas jam IED.
Kualifikasi interoperabilitas fisik R7/R10 dan paritas SCL/IID untuk engine ARIEC61850 trial yang dipin masih belum lengkap; tidak ada klaim sertifikasi semua perangkat.
PurgeBuf manual menghapus riwayat IED yang tersimpan. Gunakan hanya pada BRCB uji yang idle dan berizin setelah memahami akibatnya; ARSAS tidak pernah menjalankannya otomatis.
Installer Windows x64 belum memiliki tanda tangan Authenticode; verifikasi SHA-256. Capture GOOSE/SV memerlukan Npcap yang disetujui dan operasi control harus mengikuti prosedur berizin.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
